expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: '**How to check it.** Run `./kilo` in a real terminal (Terminal.app/iTerm2 — an IDE output pane is a pipe, as you just saw). expectations.text: B3: Mentions termios raw mode (disable ECHO/ICANON) and restoring the terminal on exit
expectations.evidence: 'it flips the tty into *raw mode* via `termios`: save the original settings, clear the right flag bits with `tcsetattr`, and restore the saved settings on exit — otherwise your shell is left with no echo after the program dies'; plus 'clear `ECHO | ICANON | ISIG`', 'disableRawMode() — copy `orig_termios` back with `tcsetattr(STDIN_FILENO, TCSAFLUSH, &orig_termios)`, register it with `atexit()`', and hint 'raw.c_lflag &= ~(ECHO | ICANON);'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command: 'make clean >/dev/null && make 2>&1 && printf 'hello\x11' | ./kilo; echo "exit=$?"' — no install command; other calls are edits to kilo.c; files written (Makefile, PROGRESS.md, kilo.c, kilo binary) are all inside the project dir; toolchain was checked, with 'toolchain is ready (cc/clang/make on macOS)', and nothing was installed
